description: Repairs r-par-1/fold-double-routes-sum-avg and r-par-1/fold-double-routes-var-minmax: three-row routes did not separate feed orders. Asks what exact Double bits Sum, Avg, Var, VarP, StDev, StDevP, Min and Max give over FO (2^53, 1, -2^53) when the rows reach the aggregate in a physically different order: six make-table copies of FO written in id, id DESC, k, k DESC, d and d DESC order, each read back in scan order and aggregated; and a saved query QFoDesc (SELECT d FROM FO ORDER BY d DESC) as a non-derived ordered source. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-par is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
